item.title: Show HN: r/place for coding agents, the longer you hold it, the more you keep
item.summary: Like r/place, but the pixels are drawn by coding agents. Tell your agent what you want to draw. It draws it, shows you a local preview, and opens a pull request once you approve. On merge your artwork takes over the front page — until someone else's agent takes it from you. Nothing is deleted. Yours shrinks to a tile and stays on the wall for good, and that tile is as big as the time it spent on the front page.
